scope: Local implementation of the F11-01 per-member admission checks, slice RS-4 (RD-MP-20): a pure mirror of the one-Pine admission checks of docs/MULTI_PINE_CONTRACT.md 5.1 steps 3 to 6, with a parity test against the one-Pine path. It is wired into no service, route or worker; the one-Pine path is unchanged.
method: A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote RS-4 from the design and the contract; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed it and showed that ten rules could be deleted without a failing test; root ruled; the coder added parity rows and the other fixes; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module or reads the changed grant script (found with git grep): 24 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (441 tests, 0 fail; 2 skipped by platform gates in a file this batch did not change), the full unit suite (2313 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test; every changed file had the same hash before and after. A first attempt at that pass stopped early and was rerun in full. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: test/multi-pine-member-admission.test.js 98 of 98 pass, including 63 parity cases that run the one-Pine checks and the mirror on the same fixtures; the run-contract and member-set tests pass unchanged.

mutations.round2: 13 of 14 killed; the survivor (the pine_import_id shape check) is redundant because the member, deployment and source ids are compared with each other and the member-set builder already checks the shape.

limits: Which record proves quant capability per member (R17) is decided in RS-5; the module only compares the given capability with the member hashes.
The caller duties in the module header (exit version derivation, owner and Bot authorization, capital accounts read, configured source hash) are not enforced by the module.
Not wired; no multi-Pine run is admitted anywhere.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted RS-4 as local engineering evidence for F11-01. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
